rationale: Frozen BEFORE the first measurement and never tuned afterwards. Per actor: one client Lua mod doing a fixed 32-iteration loop per RunService.Heartbeat (the smallest realistic per-frame body: read, loop, write), one persistent task.wait loop (keeps a live scheduler thread per actor, as real Roblox scripts do), one RemoteEvent round trip every 6 frames (10 Hz per actor, answered by the host server mod with a targeted FireClient), and one Part spawn/destroy every 30 frames through the ACL/quota-checked registry. Chat: production QueuedAiOrchestrator with the production default MaxPending (64) and the G10-frozen concurrency (4) over a fixed 100 ms scripted provider; one synchronized burst (all actors at measurement frame 0) and one staggered wave (each actor once, uniformly over the second half of the window). Frames are logical 1/60 s, paced to wall clock; per-frame CPU is measured regardless of pacing.

budgets.passRule: A step passes a frame budget only when EVERY repeat's median main-thread frame time is within the budget, every frozen work counter is non-zero, the chat gate holds (0 admission refusals, all offered requests served, p95 end-to-end <= p95EndToEndBudgetMilliseconds for both patterns) and the managed heap slope is within heapSlopeMegabytesPerMinuteMax. Worst frames and p99 are reported, never hidden.
